title: Repair a blocked task caption
prompt: caption takes an Entry. A blocked entry should return its reason exactly, including empty text. A ready entry should return "Ready". Repair the starter diagnostic while keeping this function safe for both shapes.
hints: The diagnostic points to a field found on just one member of Entry.
Look for the field present on every Entry.
Read reason inside the branch where the tag guarantees that field exists.
checks: caption({ kind: "blocked", reason: "Waiting on Lee" }) === "Waiting on Lee"

wrongAnswers.misconception: Attempts to read reason before narrowing.
Treats empty text as a ready task.

feedback: Use the tag to distinguish blocked entries. An empty reason is still a valid blocked reason.
